n52.error: NotImplementedError: port 'ant' is distributed (a finite-gap port spanning its whole named wire) — the NEC-5 multiport-Y route serves delta-gap ports only. PyNEC serves this by driving every segment at V/S and reading the weighted current; NEC-5's EX addresses KNOTS, so the same expansion needs a knot-weighting rule that has not been derived. Run this design on bspline or PyNEC.
